lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The highest-luminance maxima are concentrated in the mid-lateral zone between the primary and secondary longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of moderately elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectilinear grid, with spots acting as nodes at the intersection of these vertical bands and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. Each ridge manifests as a narrow horizontal band of high-intensity pixels (specular highlight) immediately superior to a parallel band of low-intensity pixels (occlusion shadow).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-12 distinct high-luminance blobs concentrated near the base and trailing edge. The apex of the fin is partially occluded by surface-level brown macroalgae.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-contrast white linear object is attached to the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, suggesting a trailing tag or parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A large remora is visible in the ventral-lateral field, positioned below the shark's primary longitudinal ridge.
